remarks:
ATTENTION ALL OUTDOOR ENTHUSIASTS! YOUR PRIVATE COUNTRY PARADISE AWAITS!   If you’ve been dreaming of peaceful country living surrounded by nature, look no further—THIS IS IT! Nestled on 3 beautiful acres, set back approximately 300 feet from the road, and surrounded by mature trees and wildlife, this one-of-a-kind property offers the privacy and tranquility you’ve been searching for!
Located in an agricultural district, this incredible property features a 30x40 pole barn with electric, a large wooded lot, and plenty of room to enjoy the great outdoors!   Step inside and immediately feel the warmth and charm of this cozy country home! The spacious living room features a beautiful fireplace, perfect for those chilly evenings. Just off the living room, you’ll fall in love with the gorgeous sunporch, complete with skylights, FOUR sliding glass doors, and beautiful flooring! This inviting space offers an additional 176 sq. ft. not included in the home’s listed square footage!    The charming country kitchen features Corian countertops, oak cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances that stay! A formal dining room with a cozy nook provides the perfect setting for gatherings. The first floor also offers a convenient bedroom, half bath, and mudroom.   Upstairs, you’ll find a versatile loft area and two generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space. The partial basement includes laundry with Maytag appliances that stay, a sump pump, and a hot water tank that’s just a few years old.   The attached 2+ car garage with workshop offers even more space for hobbies, storage, and projects!   Outside is where this property truly shines! Relax on the charming wooden front porch, enjoy the low-maintenance composite walkway leading around to the backyard, or entertain on the large exposed aggregate patio complete with a fire pit! Imagine peaceful evenings under the stars, surrounded by the sights and sounds of nature!   Lovingly maintained over the years, this unique, move-in-ready country retreat offers the perfect combination of privacy, comfort, and outdoor living!   Properties like this don’t come along every day!   OPEN HOUSE: SUNDAY, 10/18th 11–1PM.
